When a child’s teeth come in crooked

Dr. Asma discusses what parents can bring up at a child’s dental visit.

What to notice

Note when the change began and mention any habits such as thumb sucking. Bring up problems with biting or changes you have seen as teeth come through.

What an assessment can clarify

The dentist can look at how the teeth and bite are developing and explain whether monitoring or follow-up is appropriate. Timing depends on the child and the concern.
